bio.text: Rob Bresnahan Jr. represents Pennsylvania's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House, elected to the 119th Congress, and serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure, Agriculture and Small Business committees.
Born and raised in the Wyoming Valley, he earned a business administration degree from the University of Scranton.
He became CEO of the family electrical contractor Kuharchik Construction in 2013 and founded a real estate development group.
